title.en: The One With Make Me Be Quiet

description.es: Marta y Pelayo hablan sobre Fina en el despacho. Pelayo le dice a Marta que puede contarle a Fina que él es homosexual. En la tienda, Marta le dice a Fina que Pelayo es homosexual. Marta le dice a Fina que la quiere muchísimo y que estará con ella hasta el final de su vida. Aquí es donde está la famosa escena en la que Fina llama a Marta "Señora Directora" y Marta le dice a Fina "¿Que me calle? Cállame tú".
description.en: Marta and Pelayo talk about Fina in the office. Pelayo tells Marta that she can tell Fina that he is homosexual. At the store, Marta tells Fina that Pelayo is homosexual. Marta tells Fina that she loves her very much and that she will be with her until the end of her life. This is the famous scene where Fina calls Marta "Señora Directora" and Marta tells Fina to silence her herself "You want me to be quiet? Then silence me yourself".
